node.title: Car Evolution Mobility OS – Product Annex
node.reading:
This annex defines the current Car Evolution Mobility Operating System as a product architecture.

Car Evolution is not presented here as a consumer app, a dashboard or a research concept. It is a mobility orchestration layer for cities, campuses, resorts, airports, industrial parks, mobility operators and regions that need to coordinate transport capacity they already have.

Car Evolution provides that layer: it converts demand, available capacity, policy constraints, scenario weights and live execution feedback into coordinated operating decisions.

relations: Residual-focused search could complement Mobility OS repair by revisiting only the part whose validity has changed.
Es una propuesta de correspondencia de mecanismos. Reutilizar estado requiere clave de versión de política, disponibilidad y ventana temporal; cachear sin invalidar puede fallar.
Policy-version and expiry checks could make the boundary between a planned assignment and an authorized action explicit.
El artículo Phylons separa sustrato verificado y diseño de supervisor; este patrón se propone para evaluación y no documenta ya un módulo Mobility OS.
Identity, temporary allocation and responsibility transfer are distinct modeling questions in both piece and mobility orchestration.
La custodia de lujo no equivale a transportar pasajeros; derechos, riesgos y privacidad son diferentes. No unificar datasets por la mera analogía.
A cross-operator assignment should carry the context and acceptance conditions that allow each responsible operator to authorize its own action.
Es una extensión de diseño que debe contrastarse con contratos e interfaces reales; no una función general ya validada.
The field series suggests treating connectivity, institutional capacity and existing fleets as integration inputs for Mobility OS rather than as exceptions to an ideal platform.
La aplicabilidad es propuesta; requiere comprobar el soporte y las obligaciones del producto en cada perfil.
The paper transfer protocol offers a concrete way to ask what a mobility commitment must preserve across actors before choosing its digital representation.
Un boleto histórico no es una credencial del producto actual ni prueba una implementación técnica de sus módulos.
Tuxpan provides a field example of coordinating existing mobility capacity through rights and signals, while the current Product Annex states the scope of today's platform.
Linaje funcional no demuestra que los módulos actuales estuvieran implementados en 2010 ni que todo el producto esté validado por ese caso.
A mobility orchestration capability can travel between domains only if the receiving context’s actors, obligations and constraints are made explicit.
El anexo incluye diseño y estados de evidencia propios; el vínculo no afirma despliegue probado en todos los dominios enumerados.
A mobility orchestration design can distinguish recommendation, reservation, commitment and execution, with material changes triggering the appropriate requalification or confirmation.
Es una propuesta de aplicación a un producto actual, no evidencia de conformidad ya implantada ni norma adoptada.
A mobility decision should bind regime evidence, control support and permission to the same operation, version and useful time interval.
Diseño propuesto; no se afirma que el producto ya implemente este contrato de composición.
A constructed shared-capacity scenario could test whether locally valid mobility decisions remain coherent at the declared system boundary.
No se afirma ejecución del ensayo, producción implantada o fallo observado de Mobility OS.
